summary: Malicious Nx npm versions weaponized local AI CLIs (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Amazon Q) to hunt credentials (s1ngularity)
agent: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Amazon Q CLI (abused locally)
root_cause: Malicious Nx and plugin versions, live a little over five hours, ran a postinstall script that invoked installed AI CLIs with unsafe flags to find SSH keys, npm/GitHub tokens and wallets, then published them Base64-encoded to a public GitHub repo named s1ngularity-repository. Sources disagree on initial access (pull_request_target workflow flaw vs token leak vs phishing).
would_have_prevented: not exposing AI CLIs with permission-bypass flags to untrusted code
